definitions.target: Midpoint of the stated range in RUB per month; a single stated bound stands for itself. Amounts as the source states them: no period or gross/net field exists in trudvsem, Habr Career or SuperJob.
definitions.population: IT dedup entities (rule role bucket not not_it) of trudvsem, Habr Career and SuperJob with a RUB salary, latest record of each entity, part-time vacancies left out, the latest record extracted by the model named in the config with a role other than non_it.
definitions.feature_sets: rules: role, grade, skills, region and experience of the marts rules; student: the same schema fields as the fine-tuned extractor gave them. Same rows, split and models for both.
definitions.selection: The feature set of /salary is the one with lower dev MAE of boosting with CQR when the paired bootstrap interval of the difference excludes zero, otherwise selection.on_tie of the config.
definitions.split: Connected components over entity, dedup text cluster, extraction-corpus group and employer with one normalized title lie in one split; corpus gold test and dev groups pinned; calib is part of train.
definitions.mae_rub: Mean absolute error of the point against the midpoint, RUB per month.
definitions.within_20pct: Share of vacancies whose point is within 20% of the midpoint.
definitions.coverage: Share of vacancies whose midpoint lies in [low, high].
definitions.width_rub: Mean high - low, RUB per month.
definitions.ci: Percentile bootstrap over dev groups (whole components), resamples and seed in configs/eval.toml; differences are paired on the same resamples.
definitions.importance: Rise of dev MAE of the boosting point when the columns of one input are shuffled across dev rows; shuffling breaks correlated inputs together only within a block.
definitions.shap: Exact Shapley values of the boosting point model (log salary) with the eight inputs of BLOCKS as players, interventional over a background sample of train rows; pct is exp(mean SHAP) - 1.

limits_ru: Поля студента содержат ошибки извлечения, правила витрин свои ошибки; сравнение наборов признаков отвечает на вопрос, какой вход лучше для этой модели, а не какой экстрактор точнее.
Gross или net источники не указывают, суммы взяты как опубликованы; источник стоит признаком.
Почти все строки из trudvsem (портал «Работа России»), Хабр Карьера и SuperJob дают сотни вакансий: оценка для source=habr и source=superjob опирается на малую выборку.
Цель это середина опубликованной вилки; вилка «от X» без верхней границы считается как X.
SHAP описывает модель, а не рынок: вклад признака в прогноз при остальных признаках из фона, без причинного смысла (сдвиг вилки от навыка оценивается отдельно в skill_effects.json).

selection.reason: interval of the difference covers zero, tie rule picks student
